Maintain structured documentation of data logic, transformations, and validation frameworks
Build reusable SQL and Python workflows to reduce manual reporting effort
Support automation of recurring regulatory processes and validation checks
Contribute to scalable data models supporting regulatory dashboards and executive reporting
Develop dashboards and visualizations (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, etc.) to monitor regulatory metrics and data quality trends
Perform structured analysis to support remediation tracking and compliance risk monitoring

Advanced Excel skills
Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, etc.)
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities

The Business Analyst / Project Manager will support a transformation program for a top-tier banking client, aligned to an ECB Remediation approach.

Description of role and key responsibilities
We are seeking a highly analytical and technically strong Power BI Data Analyst with solid programming expertise to transform complex datasets into meaningful insights. The ideal candidate combines advanced Power BI skills with strong programming capabilities (Python, SQL, DAX, etc.) to design scalable data models, automate workflows, and deliver impactful business intelligence solutions.
This role involves working closely with various stakeholders to understand their data needs and delivering high-quality, performant reports / dashboards and visualizations.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Data Collection and Management:
- Gather data from various sources, ensuring accuracy and consistency. - Support Data Engineers to maintain and manage databases, ensuring data integrity and security.
2. Data Analysis:
Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies.
Apply statistical techniques and models to interpret data and generate insights.
3. Data Modelling and Transformation
Define datamodel attributes
Build efficient data models using best practices (star schema, relationships, measures).
Optimization of Data models and Semantic Models using tools
4. Reporting and Visualisation:
Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards and reports as per persona/stakeholder requirements.
Develop complex DAX calculations, KPIs, and time-intelligence metrics.
Optimize report performance and implement row-level security (RLS).
Ensure data visualizations communicate insights clearly to stakeholders.
5. Reusable scripts/ Reports/ CI/CD
Develop Python scripts for automation, data processing, and advanced analytics.
Integrate Power BI with external systems and APIs.
Automate recurring reports and data refresh workflows.
Implement version control and documentation for BI solutions.
6. Collaboration with Stakeholders:
Work closely with business analyst to understand their data requirements and provide analytical support.
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
7. Quality Assurance:
Ensure the accuracy and reliability of data through validation and quality control processes.
Identify and address data quality issues proactively.
8. Continuous Improvement:
Stay updated on industry trends, tools, and best practices in data analysis.
Suggest improvements to data processes and methodologies for enhanced efficiency.
Develop and promote reuse, standards and practices via playbooks
Collaborate with COE community to drive group analytics context within /across teams via knowledge sharing sessions
Cultivate & participate in culture focused on data quality, data governance, data security best practices

4 - 8 years of Proven experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytical role.
Strong understanding of data warehousing, data modelling, dimensional modelling methodologies such as Kimball and BI / analytics workflows.
Proficiency in data analysis and manipulation using SQL, stored procedures
Proficiency in data visualization software (Power BI).
Able to build Data Models (Semantic Models) and optimize them for reporting.
Proven experience in Azure Data Platform technologies: o Databricks/ Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure Data Lake, SQL.
Experience developing or supporting executive-level reporting or dashboards.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
Knowledge of programming languages Python.
Ability to work with large, complex datasets
Any other attributes that would be helpful, but not essential for the role.
Experience working in data mesh architecture.
Experience in Fabric Agents, Power BI to Fabric Migration,
Ability to translate business requirements into data and technical design artifacts.
Exposure to data lineage / metadata management tools (e.g., Purview).

Experience with statistical analysis and forecasting

AkzoNobel has started its journey to mature its Master Data Management (MDM) Services, and for this, setting up Global MDM capabilities is essential. The MDM Analyst/Steward will execute Material Master data maintenance processes within SLAs, including its controls and monitor master data quality definitions and rules.

Role & responsibilities
Responsible for executing activities done by the MDM Materials Operations team within all capabilities provided, i.e. Material Data maintenance processes, controls, SLAs, point of contact for MDM CoE and business, issue solving (root cause analysis), Master Data Materials Quality monitoring.
Adhere to SLAs and report/escalate to Team Lead and Service Delivery Manager in case of exceptions
Conduct root cause analyses and IM touchpoint for system issues fixes
Monitoring of Material Master data quality.
Collaborate with Global Material Expert periodically to collect, collate and analyse data for DQ metrics
Support implementing and monitoring of Material data quality rules and Material data definitions.
Validation of the request against Material data rules (impact assessment) and determines whether the data record already exists
Closing and filing requests for material data
Notifying the Materials User on the status of requests (e.g. rejected requests and reason)
Responsible for materials entry into information systems
Responsible to respond to business for additional information on completeness of materials data requests
Good communication and teamwork within and across organizational boundaries
Support Global Materials Expert and Team Lead on process standardization and optimisation to drive down total cost to serve and enhance customer satisfaction through improved quality of processes
Supports the implementation of the Materials service within MDM Tower

Preferred candidate profile

Bachelor level
Minimum 4-6 years of experience in a Global shared service centre
Minimum 4 years of experience in SAP MM and Material Master Data
Working experience supporting Material Maste Data operational processes
Experience in interfacing with business operational customers and Information Management
Experience in root cause analysis
Experience in Materials Master application systems as key user (preferably SAP MM)
Experience in complex business environments with multiple stakeholders, including service providers for both IT as organizational/process capabilities
Experience in ticketing system - preferably ServiceNow
Advanced English communication skills

You will be aligned with our Life Sciences RD vertical. They often utilize specialized software and systems to manage the data efficiently.A critical phase in clinical research that assures collection, integration and availability of data at appropriate quality and cost. It also supports the conduct, management and analysis of studies across the spectrum of clinical research as defined by the National Institutes of Health (NIH).

Ability to establish strong client relationship
Ability to handle disputes

Ability to perform under pressure

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to work on a broad range of data analytics, data visualization, and business intelligence initiatives across multiple industries. The role requires strong analytical skills, frequent client interaction, and the ability to translate business problems into effective analytical and BI solutions while collaborating closely with Data Engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

Work on a wide range of data analytics, data visualization, and business intelligence problems across various industries.
Engage with clients and business stakeholders to understand business context, objectives, and challenges.
Analyze and document business processes, mapping end-to-end workflows using visual formats such as process flow diagrams.

Track work items, enhancements, and issues using JIRA.

Strong hands-on experience with Tableau and Snowflake (mandatory), including:
Dashboard development and publishing
Calculated fields, filters, parameters, and LOD calculations
Data blending and joins
Row-Level Security (RLS) implementation
Replacing and managing data sources
Experience with Snowflake (mandatory) as a primary data warehouse.
Ability to perform QC checks and validation on dashboards and reports.
Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
Experience in preparing MoM, requirement documents, and functional
documentation.
Hands-on experience working with JIRA for task tracking and project management.

Desired Skills & Competencies

Experience with other BI tools such as Power BI (added advantage).
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to handle complex business problems.
Proven experience interacting with clients and business stakeholders for requirement gathering and solution design.
Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights clearly through effective storyboarding and data narratives.
Ability to work independently while managing multiple stakeholders and priorities.

 We are seeking for an Sr Analyst, you will be the guardian of our data quality, acting as a critical link between raw web data and client-facing insights. This role is perfect for a hands-on specialist who enjoys the "puzzle" of reverse-engineering websites and fixing complex, low-level data issues with precision and efficiency.
 We are OGS—Omnicom's Integrated Solutions Engine that brings together a global talent community and connected capabilities in data, creative, media, commerce, and technology to build adaptive, future-ready solutions. 
We are redefining the global capability center - not as an offshoring hub, but as a true inside edge. OGS is the place where the future is tested, built, and scaled for the world’s most ambitious agencies and clients. 
With over 4300+ talented professionals in India, we are proud to be a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative community that thrives on innovation and excellence. Our teams work with some of the world’s most iconic brands, helping them move faster and achieve more—everywhere. We are growing rapidly and looking for passionate individuals to be part of this journey.
Responsibilities
Monitor & Triage: Perform daily health checks on our ETL and Parser data pipelines. You will be the first responder to automated data quality alerts, investigating a high volume of On-Hold jobs and making decisive calls to stop faulty data feeds.
Investigate & Diagnose: Dive deep into data anomalies using our internal Detector platform. You'll compare system data against live websites, inspect raw HTML/JSON, and perform root cause analysis to accurately distinguish between parsing bugs, legitimate site changes, and source data errors.
Develop, Fix & Optimize: Based on your investigations, you will take direct ownership of fixing the extraction logic. This involves writing, editing, and debugging data extraction patterns using our declarative language, including parsing complex embedded JSON (Jackson JQ)
Handle Ad-Hoc Feature Development: Field incoming requests from stakeholders to add new data fields, managing the full development-to-production lifecycle.
Lead New Domain Discovery: Manage the end-to-end process for on-boarding new websites, from creating patterns from scratch to coordinating the final release.
Test & Release: Adhere to a rigorous QA workflow by running QA jobs to validate all changes against large datasets before release.
Document & Collaborate: Maintain meticulous records in Jira and communicate directly with stakeholders to clarify requirements and provide updates.
Qualifications
Required Skills:
  Proven experience in data quality, data operations, or web scraping-focused role.
Strong technical proficiency in reading, navigating, and understanding HTML and complex, nested JSON structures.
 Hands-on experience writing extraction logic from scratch using CSS Selectors and RegEx, not just using pre-built connectors or low-code tools.
Proficiency with JQ for parsing and manipulating complex, embedded JSON objects.
A strong focus on performance and optimization, with the ability to write efficient, maintainable patterns that scale.
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with an obsessive attention to detail.
The ability to work methodically through complex, multi-step technical workflows and adhere to a rigorous QA process.

title: Analyst - Data Science - MLOps Engineer
description:
Analyst - Data Science MLOps Engineer Location: Bengaluru, India Job reference: R-246618 Date posted: 02/26/2026

Job Title: Analyst - Data Science MLOps Engineer
Career Level: C3
Shift: 2 pm to 11 pm IST
Location: Manyata Tech Park, Bangalore.


Introduction to role:
The Data Science MLOps Engineer role collaborates with data scientists, analysts, and commercial operations to design, deploy, and manage machine learning systems that enhance sales effectiveness and engagement. This position is responsible for ensuring that models are reproducible, compliant, performant, and scalable throughout their lifecycle from experimentation to production. A strong focus is placed on data quality, monitoring, and governance.


Accountabilities:
Model Lifecycle Management: Develop and maintain pipelines to transition models from experimentation to production, including packaging, CI/CD, automated testing, and deployment across multiple environments.
Data Pipeline Development: Design robust batch and streaming data workflows; define and manage feature sets, lineage, and reuse to support AI/ML initiatives.
Production Operations: Ensure reliability and scalability of ML systems; manage incident response, on-call support, and implement effective logging, tracing, and alerting.
Monitoring Observability: Establish comprehensive monitoring for model performance, data drift, bias, and service health; set thresholds, create dashboards, and automate remediation processes.
Model Governance Compliance: Implement version control, approvals, documentation, and audit trails for datasets, code, models, and experiments; ensure compliance with privacy regulations (HIPAA/PHI, GDPR) and support AZ IT compliance requirements as needed.
Experiment Management: Standardize experiment tracking and artifact management; promote standard processes for feature engineering, model packaging, and dependency management.
Release Change Management: Coordinate releases with commercial operations and IT; maintain runbooks, rollback strategies, change tickets, and release notes in alignment with enterprise processes.
Security Access Controls: Enforce secrets management, role-based access control, network policies, and data protection for sensitive healthcare and commercial data.
Cost Optimization: Monitor and optimize cloud and computing costs for training, inference, and data movement; select architectures that balance performance with budget constraints.
Collaboration Enablement: Work closely with data scientists and business partners; provide frameworks, templates, and guardrails; conduct training and code reviews to support engineering standards.
Documentation Knowledge Sharing: Develop clear technical documentation, operational playbooks, and user guides for models, pipelines, and platform components.


Essential Skills/Experience:
Education: bachelors or masters degree in Computer Science, or Data Science, or ML Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.
Experience: 3 6+ years in ML engineering or MLOps, or Data Science with MLOps, or ML Platform roles, with a proven track record of deploying ML solutions at scale.
Programming: SQL, Python, orchestration, data science pipelines, end-to-end ML frameworks (ex: scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch), PySpark (preferred for future needs), Airflow, DBT, Snowflake, MLflow experience with unit and integration testing, and code quality standards.
CI/CD Infrastructure: Experience with CI/CD tools (eg, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) and containerization (Docker).
ML Tools: Hands-on experience with model packaging and serving frameworks (eg, SageMaker, Azure ML), and experiment tracking tools.
Data Technologies: Proficiency with distributed processing (Spark), data orchestration (Airflow), and cloud data services (eg, Azure Data Lake, Snowflake, AWS S3).
Security Compliance: Understanding data privacy and security in healthcare; experience with secrets management and audit controls.


Desirable Skills/Experience:
Domain Experience: Knowledge of pharmaceutical commercial analytics (HCP/HCO targeting, call planning, incentive compensation, demand forecasting, omnichannel measurement).
Performance Scalability: Experience with high-throughput inference, batch scoring at scale, and low-latency APIs.
Workflow Reliability: Skills in incident management and capacity planning for ML systems.
Automation Templates: Ability to create reusable pipelines and starter kits for rapid project onboarding.
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to present complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Team Collaboration: Strong orientation toward teamwork and multi-functional collaboration.

title: Senior Analyst, Learning & Development - Voice/Accent
description:
Job Summary:
This position is responsible for the operation of the Contact Center department. An individual in this position will be expected to perform additional job-related responsibilities and duties as assigned and/or necessary.
About Team:
Our team is focused on developing a streamlined, dependable company that includes service operations and technology solutions for Finance, People, and Associate Digital Experience (ADE). We also provide a variety of services such as procurement, supplier portfolio management, merchandising master data, and analytics. From developing HR chatbots and virtual assistants to creating invoice solutions and facilitating legal changes, we help drive efficiency across Walmart globally.
What you'll do:
Manages the facilitation of learning activities by overseeing associate trainings on complex systems and processes and new hire onboarding; providing input to the content design team; adjusting content flow according to the requirements of the training or target audience; utilizing learning systems to monitor, track, and report learning activities; incorporating trainee feedback and performance metric results; sharing course facilitation improvements with senior management; evaluating program effectiveness against business objectives; and overseeing the maintenance and upkeep of training equipment and resources.
Develops facilitators and team members by providing feedback to enhance facilitation skills; assessing the teams performance in the sessions facilitates; making recommendations for additional training; and coaching, mentoring, and developing other associates with or without managerial supervision based on requirements by management.
Manages and delivers complex training courses by applying blended delivery methods; rehearsing course content prior to delivery; communicating complex content, policies, and processes; observing participant engagement in courses; remaining current on course materials and facilitation best practices; answering questions related to course content and concept application; and guiding associate engagement during training courses.
Essential Functions An individual must be able to successfully perform the essential functions of this position with or without reasonable accommodation. Below are the essential functions,
Understanding of English Grammar Subject Verb Agreement Rules, Tenses and Transliterations
Different Feedback Mechanism such as GROW, SOAR, OSKAR, CLEAR, AOR coaching models
Training Needs Identification and Analysis, Root Cause Analysis, and Quartile Management
Training sounds in English such as Vowels (Monophthongs and Diphthongs), Consonant sounds (Fricatives, Affricates, Plosives and Nasal)
Manner of articulation and place of articulation of English sounds
Demonstrates up-to-date expertise and applies this to the development, execution, and improvement of action plans by providing expert advice and guidance to others in the application of information and best practices; supporting and aligning efforts to meet customer and business needs; and building commitment for perspectives and rationales.
Provides and supports the implementation of business solutions by building relationships and partnerships with key stakeholders; identifying business needs; determining and carrying out necessary processes and practices; monitoring progress and results; recognizing and capitalizing on improvement opportunities; and adapting to competing demands, organizational changes, and new responsibilities.
Models compliance with company policies and procedures and supports company mission, values, and standards of ethics and integrity by incorporating these into the development and implementation of business plans; using the Open Door Policy; and demonstrating and assisting others with how to apply these in executing business processes and practices.
What you'll bring:
Basic Qualifications
Bachelors Degree in a related field and 5 years industry/related experience as a preprocess trainer, having conducted New Hire Training on Grammar and Voice/Accent
OR 6-8 years industry/related experience as a pre-process trainer, having conducted New Hire Training on Grammar and Voice/Accent
Proficient in blended training delivery methodologies
Expert in classroom training delivery
Ability to design and deliver language and culture-based course material/training curriculum
Capability to design and deliver competency-based training
Expertise in leadership training
Operational knowledge of LMS
Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suit (PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook)
Ability to manage multiple batches at the same time
Experience working with multiple team members and stakeholders
Must be able and willing to think and act strategically and tactically
Result oriented and Quality conscious
Preferred Qualifications
ADD: Knowledge of Adult Learning Theories
Prior experience and knowledge of contact center
